title: A Look Back at the Most Breathtaking Photos of Saturn From Voyager 1 - Nautilus
gist: Photo retrospective of Voyager 1's Saturn flyby 46 years ago, noting the 49-year-old spacecraft recently lost and regained contact after a power-rerouting software update and will reach one light day from Earth on November 18.

insights.claim: Voyager 1 recently went out of contact after a planned software update rerouted power to prolong its 49-year-old mission, then restored communication without a clear explanation.
insights.so_what: Shows the fragility of very long-lived space assets.
insights.quote: The spacecraft recently went inexplicably incommunicado after a carefully planned software update rerouted power
insights.speaker: Jake Currie

insights.claim: On November 18, Voyager 1 will reach one light day from Earth, the distance light travels in 24 hours.
insights.quote: On November 18th, Voyager 1 will reach one light day from Earth
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
